background.text: What D1 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a Property Owner initiates the deletion process, the Platform must display a confirmation message.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner initiates property deletion, THE Platform SHALL prompt for confirmation before proceeding
rules.reading: When a Property Owner initiates the deletion of a property, the Platform must display a confirmation prompt before the process can proceed.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner confirms deletion, THE Platform SHALL remove the Property record from the Platform
rules.reading: If a Property Owner confirms the deletion of a property, the platform must remove the property record from the platform.

alternative.reading: When a Property Owner confirms the deletion of a property, the Platform must ensure that the property is successfully deleted.

rules.text: WHEN a Property is deleted, THE Platform SHALL display a confirmation message and redirect to the properties list
rules.reading: When a property is successfully deleted, the platform must display a confirmation message and redirect the user to the properties list.

rules.text: THE Platform SHALL implement soft deletion to retain Property records in the database for audit purposes while hiding them from the user interface
rules.reading: Whenever a Property is successfully deleted from the Platform, the system must retain its record in the database while ensuring it is not visible in the user interface.

alternative.reading: The requirement mandates that Property records are always retained in the database while being hidden from the user interface, regardless of the deletion process status.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner attempts to delete a Property that does not belong to their User Account, THE Platform SHALL deny the deletion and display an authorization error message
rules.reading: If a Property Owner initiates a deletion for a Property that is not owned by them, the Platform must deny the request and show an authorization error.
